summary: Inspect an installed Codex skill collection and surface overlap, catalog pressure, and consolidation candidates without changing it.

scenarios.title: Find overlapping installed skills
scenarios.prompt: Use $audit-skill-portfolio to inspect my installed skills and identify the strongest consolidation candidates.
scenarios.outcome: A read-only inventory that separates deterministic evidence from heuristic overlap and prioritizes a short decision list.

scenarios.title: Audit one repository catalog
scenarios.prompt: Use $audit-skill-portfolio for this repository's project skills and check naming, invocation policy, and trigger collisions.
scenarios.outcome: A scoped catalog report with diagnostics and tier candidates, without installing, deleting, or rewriting skills.
